title: Verify destination filter toggle on home screen
folder: Driver App > Home Screen > Destination Filter
preconditions: Driver is logged in and eligible for destination filter.
steps: 1. Navigate to Home screen. 2. Observe the destination filter toggle. 3. Enable and disable the toggle.
expected: Destination filter toggle should be visible and functional. Toggling should enable or disable destination filter accordingly.

title: Verify setting address as favourite on destination filter screen
folder: Driver App > Home Screen > Destination Filter
preconditions: Driver is on destination filter main screen with search option available.
steps: 1. Search for a location or select from map/recent addresses. 2. Set the location as favourite with a custom title. 3. Save the favourite.
expected: Address should be saved as favourite with the entered title. It should appear in favourite list for future selection.

title: Verify driver receives rides on destination filter screens all three/four screens
folder: Driver App > Home Screen > Destination Filter
preconditions: Driver is logged in and destination filter toggle is enabled.
steps: 1. Keep the app on any of the destination filter screens (main, search, favourite, recent). 2. Observe for incoming ride offers.
expected: Driver should receive rides normally while on any of the destination filter screens.

title: Verify setting destination filter using map option
folder: Driver App > Home Screen > Destination Filter
preconditions: Driver is on destination filter main screen and map is accessible.
steps: 1. Open map option. 2. Select a desired location using map pin. 3. Set it as destination filter.
expected: Destination filter should be set correctly using map pin. Selected address should match displayed location.

title: Verify setting destination filter using the search option
folder: Driver App > Home Screen > Destination Filter
preconditions: Driver is on destination filter main screen with search functionality.
steps: 1. Open search option. 2. Search for a desired location. 3. Select and set it as destination filter.
expected: Destination filter should be set correctly using search. Selected address should match searched location.

title: Verify setting destination filter using the favourite or recent addresses
folder: Driver App > Home Screen > Destination Filter
preconditions: Driver has saved favourite/recent addresses and is on destination filter screen.
steps: 1. Open favourite or recent addresses list. 2. Select a location. 3. Set it as destination filter.
expected: Destination filter should be set correctly using favourite or recent address. Selected address should match chosen location.

title: Verify turning off the destination filter flow on home screen
folder: Driver App > Home Screen > Destination Filter
steps: 1. Navigate to Home screen. 2. Turn off the destination filter toggle. 3. Observe the app behavior.
expected: Destination filter should be disabled. Driver should not receive rides filtered by previous destination.

title: Verify driver only received the ride relevant to set destination filter
folder: Driver App > Home Screen > Destination Filter
preconditions: Driver has destination filter enabled and set.
steps: 1. Keep the app online. 2. Observe incoming rides.
expected: Driver should only receive rides near the set destination. Rides outside the destination filter should not appear.

title: Verify destination filter consume notification after boarding the ride
folder: Driver App > Home Screen > Destination Filter
preconditions: Driver has active destination filter and receives ride offer.
steps: 1. Accept ride with destination filter active. 2. Board the passenger. 3. Observe the destination filter usage count notification.
expected: Destination filter usage count should decrease by 1 after boarding. Notification should appear reflecting usage.

title: Verify the allowed destination filter count after completing the rides allowed per day with destination filter
folder: Driver App > Home Screen > Destination Filter
preconditions: Driver is on destination filter main screen and has limited destination filter usage per day.
steps: 1. Use destination filter for rides until daily limit is reached. 2. Observe count decrement on destination filter main screen.
expected: Destination filter count should decrease with every ride and reach 0 after daily limit. Driver cannot set new destination after limit is reached.

title: Verify driver can set a destination filter after limit reach
folder: Driver App > Home Screen > Destination Filter
preconditions: Driver has reached daily destination filter usage limit and is on Home screen.
steps: 1. Press destination filter toggle on Home screen. 2. Observe prompt behavior.
expected: A prompt should appear stating 'You can't set more destinations today'. Destination filter should not be enabled until next day/reset.
